svg.title: One rotation, two coordinate descriptions
svg.desc: Left: a point P at angle pi over three on the unit circle has coordinates cosine theta and sine theta. Its horizontal and vertical projections are marked. Right: the same angle and height are marked on the sine graph from zero to two pi.
